comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight cap and tip a battery into a collection bin, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated threaded-cap regrasping and device tipping differ from loosening a captive setscrew, withdrawing the bit, rotating a separate collar, reacquiring its moved socket, and tuning response.
comparison.success_condition: Success is cap removal/set-down, battery collection, and flashlight set-down without drops; the candidate requires two bounded impact cycles and less than 2 degrees of collar drift.
comparison.reason: There is some rotary regrasping, but the mechanism and tested outcome are materially different: disassembly/extraction versus retained parameter adjustment validated dynamically.
